title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt mask-wearing over time under social influence, policies, information, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe and are influenced by mask-wearing behaviors and opinions of their social ties.

interactions.name: policy_compliance_and_enforcement
interactions.description: Policies (mandates or recommendations) affect the probability of mask use; locations may enforce by denying entry or issuing fines.

interactions.name: media_and_information_exposure
interactions.description: Media channels broadcast messages that shift attitudes and risk perception.

interactions.name: mask_purchase_and_supply
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks subject to price, budget, and local inventory.

interactions.name: norm_observation_in_locations
interactions.description: Observed local compliance in locations shapes perceived norms and future adoption decisions.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each timestep; can be averaged over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_threshold
metrics.description: Number of days to reach a specified adoption threshold (adoption_target_percent).

metrics.name: compliance_rate_under_mandate
metrics.description: Mask-wearing rate in locations with mandates during the mandate period.

metrics.name: adoption_by_demographic
metrics.description: Adoption rates segmented by attributes such as age, income, or risk group to detect disparities.

metrics.name: supply_constraint_gap
metrics.description: Proportion of agents willing to adopt but unable to due to insufficient mask access or budget.

metrics.name: post_policy_sustainment
metrics.description: Average adoption rate after mandates or campaigns end, indicating persistence of behavior.
